struct Request

  std::string name
  std::vector<std::string> rights
  std::string secret
  std::string token
  std::string right
  std::string why

  std::string admin

  std::string name

  std::string registered

  std::string right

struct Subject

  std::string program
struct Decision

  std::string policy_revision
struct PolicyRule

  std::string action
  std::string resource
  bool permit
struct PolicyPage

  std::string revision

  std::vector<PolicyRule> rules
  std::string next
  bool complete

struct Authorization
  virtual DescriptionPage list_action_descriptions(const std::string& cursor, const std::int64_t& limit)
  virtual Decision decide(const std::string& action, const std::string& resource)
  virtual Decision decide_for(const Subject& subject, const std::string& action, const std::string& resource)
template<class Transport>struct AuthorizationClient : Authorization
  Transport& transport_
  DescriptionPage list_action_descriptions(const std::string& cursor, const std::int64_t& limit) override
  Decision decide(const std::string& action, const std::string& resource) override
  Decision decide_for(const Subject& subject, const std::string& action, const std::string& resource) override
struct AuthorizationService
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kWireName
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kCapability
struct AuthorizationDispatcher : FrameWriter, FrameExchanger
  Authorization& handler
  DescribedService describe_service() const
  void write_frame(std::string_view frame) override
  std::string exchange_frame(std::string_view frame) override
struct AuthorizationOperator
  virtual DescriptionEdit register_described_action(const std::string& expected_revision, const ActionDescription& description)
  virtual PolicyEdit apply_first_use_allow(const std::string& expected_revision, const std::string& question_id)
  virtual PolicyPage list_policy(const std::string& cursor, const std::int64_t& limit)
  virtual PolicyEdit set_rule(const std::string& expected_revision, const PolicyRule& rule)
  virtual PolicyEdit revoke_rule(const std::string& expected_revision, const Subject& subject, const std::string& action, const std::string& resource)
  virtual PolicyEdit stop_answerer(const std::string& expected_revision, const Subject& answerer, const bool& also_revoke_grants)
  virtual PolicyEdit revoke_answer_permits(const std::string& expected_revision, const Subject& answerer, const Subject& target, const std::vector<std::string>& actions, const std::string& resource, const std::string& question_id)
  virtual PolicyEdit set_rule_for(const std::string& expected_revision, const PolicyRule& rule, const std::int64_t& ttl_ms, const std::string& why)
  virtual PolicyEdit set_rules_for(const std::string& expected_revision, const std::vector<PolicyRule>& rules, const std::int64_t& ttl_ms, const std::string& why)
  virtual RuleRead read_rule(const Subject& subject, const std::string& action, const std::string& resource)
  virtual ActionEdit register_action(const std::string& expected_revision, const std::string& action)
  virtual ActionEdit retire_action(const std::string& expected_revision, const std::string& action)
  virtual DecisionExplanation explain_for(const Subject& subject, const std::string& action, const std::string& resource)
  virtual DefaultPage list_defaults()
  virtual DefaultEdit set_default(const std::string& expected_revision, const std::string& name, const bool& on)
template<class Transport>struct AuthorizationOperatorClient : AuthorizationOperator
  Transport& transport_
  DescriptionEdit register_described_action(const std::string& expected_revision, const ActionDescription& description) override
  PolicyEdit apply_first_use_allow(const std::string& expected_revision, const std::string& question_id) override
  PolicyPage list_policy(const std::string& cursor, const std::int64_t& limit) override
  PolicyEdit set_rule(const std::string& expected_revision, const PolicyRule& rule) override
  PolicyEdit revoke_rule(const std::string& expected_revision, const Subject& subject, const std::string& action, const std::string& resource) override
  PolicyEdit stop_answerer(const std::string& expected_revision, const Subject& answerer, const bool& also_revoke_grants) override
  PolicyEdit revoke_answer_permits(const std::string& expected_revision, const Subject& answerer, const Subject& target, const std::vector<std::string>& actions, const std::string& resource, const std::string& question_id) override
  PolicyEdit set_rule_for(const std::string& expected_revision, const PolicyRule& rule, const std::int64_t& ttl_ms, const std::string& why) override
  PolicyEdit set_rules_for(const std::string& expected_revision, const std::vector<PolicyRule>& rules, const std::int64_t& ttl_ms, const std::string& why) override
  RuleRead read_rule(const Subject& subject, const std::string& action, const std::string& resource) override
  ActionEdit register_action(const std::string& expected_revision, const std::string& action) override
  ActionEdit retire_action(const std::string& expected_revision, const std::string& action) override
  DecisionExplanation explain_for(const Subject& subject, const std::string& action, const std::string& resource) override
  DefaultPage list_defaults() override
  DefaultEdit set_default(const std::string& expected_revision, const std::string& name, const bool& on) override

  inline static constexpr std::string_view kWireName

  virtual BatchDecision check_batch_for(const Subject& subject, const CheckBatchRequest& request)
  virtual Decision check_legacy_operation_for(const Subject& subject, const LegacyOperationRequest& request)

  BatchDecision check_batch(const CheckBatchRequest& request) override

  Decision check_legacy_operation_for(const Subject& subject, const LegacyOperationRequest& request) override

struct SelectorAuthorizationOperator
  virtual SelectorRulePage list_selector_rules(const std::string& cursor, const std::int64_t& limit)
  virtual SelectorRuleRead read_selector_rule(const Subject& subject, const PermissionSelection& selection)
  virtual SelectorEdit set_selector_rule(const std::string& expected_revision, const SelectorRule& rule, const std::int64_t& ttl_ms, const std::string& why)
  virtual SelectorEdit remove_selector_rule(const std::string& expected_revision, const Subject& subject, const PermissionSelection& selection)
  virtual SelectorEdit apply_bundle(const std::string& expected_revision, const Subject& subject, const std::string& bundle_ref, const ResourceSelector& selector, const std::int64_t& ttl_ms, const std::string& why)
  virtual SelectorEdit remove_bundle(const std::string& expected_revision, const Subject& subject, const std::string& origin_id)
  virtual SelectorEdit apply_permission_allow(const std::string& expected_revision, const std::string& question_id)
  virtual SelectorEdit undo_permission_effect(const std::string& expected_revision, const std::string& question_id)
template<class Transport>struct SelectorAuthorizationOperatorClient : SelectorAuthorizationOperator
  Transport& transport_
  SelectorRulePage list_selector_rules(const std::string& cursor, const std::int64_t& limit) override
  SelectorRuleRead read_selector_rule(const Subject& subject, const PermissionSelection& selection) override
  SelectorEdit set_selector_rule(const std::string& expected_revision, const SelectorRule& rule, const std::int64_t& ttl_ms, const std::string& why) override
  SelectorEdit remove_selector_rule(const std::string& expected_revision, const Subject& subject, const PermissionSelection& selection) override
  SelectorEdit apply_bundle(const std::string& expected_revision, const Subject& subject, const std::string& bundle_ref, const ResourceSelector& selector, const std::int64_t& ttl_ms, const std::string& why) override
  SelectorEdit remove_bundle(const std::string& expected_revision, const Subject& subject, const std::string& origin_id) override
  SelectorEdit apply_permission_allow(const std::string& expected_revision, const std::string& question_id) override
  SelectorEdit undo_permission_effect(const std::string& expected_revision, const std::string& question_id) override
